C1761.title: Public Security Authorities Crack Down on Fake Pandemic Prevention Software
C1761.summary: During the 2022 Summer Public Security Campaign, the cyber security division of the public security authorities uncovered a series of cases involving the development, sale, and use of fake pandemic prevention software. These applications were repackaged or counterfeited with embedded malicious functions to bypass health checks and for other illegal purposes.

references.title: Public Security Authorities Crack Down on Production, Sale, and Use of Fake Epidemic Prevention Software
